title: Knowledge Graph
description: Persistent codebase memory for the Recursive Descent Analysis Agent v2.0. Stores file hashes, dependency maps, per-persona scores, and flags. Enables delta analysis on subsequent runs.

last_session.description: Date of the last analysis session

last_commit.description: Git commit hash at time of last analysis, or 'no-git' if not a git repo

total_files.description: Total files tracked in the graph

files_analyzed_this_session.description: Files that were re-analyzed in the most recent session

files_inherited.description: Files that inherited prior scores (unchanged since last analysis)

files.description: Map of file path → file analysis entry

modules.description: Map of module name → module summary

hash.description: SHA-256 hash of file contents at time of last analysis

last_analyzed.description: Date this file was last analyzed

descent_level_reached.description: Deepest descent level this file was analyzed at (0=app shell, 1=module, 2=component, 3=function)

line_count.description: Number of lines in the file

dependencies.description: Files this file imports (resolved absolute paths)

cross_persona.description: True if 2+ personas flagged this file

milestone_critical.description: Which milestones this file is on the critical path for (e.g., ['M1', 'M2'])

stale.description: True if file changed since last analysis and needs re-descent. Set during delta diff, cleared after re-analysis.

architect.description: Flags from the Architect persona (prefix: ARCH-NNN)

user.description: Flags from the User persona (prefix: USER-NNN)

adversary.description: Flags from the Adversary persona (prefix: ADV-NNN)

files.description: All file paths belonging to this module

drift_count.description: Number of documentation drift findings affecting this module
